g.text: Imported STM32MP157DAB1: native dogbone angle rejection
All 354 JLCPCB C1236721 pads retained, including their original coordinate precision.
Orange: rejected candidate only; no routed copper is returned.
X offset = 0.399923 mm; Y offset = 0.400050 mm; difference = 0.000127 mm.
The 45° check allows only 0.000001 mm difference; this candidate exceeds it.
Expected: choose a clearance-valid straight/45° candidate before committing the assignment.
Local escape only (top → inner3); R1 stays unrouted. Inner1 GND and antipads are not drawn.
Captured TSX input, native solver, no saved routes or moved pads. This does not prove full-board routing.
